outcome: Contributors can follow one coordinated development workflow with isolated writers and independently reviewed delivery.
acceptance: A contributor can claim a clean registered worktree before editing and follow the documented integration procedure.
Existing required checks and final-revision independent review remain mandatory.
failure_cases: A conflicting or third writer waits without modifying another writer's checkout.
An expired claim requires explicit reconciliation instead of automatic takeover.
Changed head or base requires new matching validation and review evidence.
validation: Parse this JSON with the coordinator's contract validator before claiming.
Verify documented commands against coordinator --help and run its subprocess concurrency tests.
Review the exact final revision and require all protected branch checks.
